examples.en: We walked along the Yangtze River.
There are famous cities along the river.
Travel along this road to the festival.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：along 音近「阿龙」，阿龙 walk along 沿着走。
语义联想：把「沿着」和英文 along 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 可作介词或副词

examples.en: You can travel anywhere in China.
examples.zh: 你可以去中国任何地方旅行。

examples.en: I cannot find my bag anywhere.
Is there a famous place anywhere near here?
examples.zh: 这附近有什么著名的地方吗？

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：anywhere 音近「埃尼威尔」，埃尼威尔 go anywhere 任何地方。
语义联想：把「任何地方」和英文 anywhere 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 常用于否定句和疑问句

examples.en: The Yangtze River is very famous.
Harbin is famous for the Ice and Snow Festival.
This is a famous travel city.
examples.zh: 这是一座著名的旅游城市。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：famous 音近「费默斯」，费默斯说 famous 著名。
形象联想：想象 famous 著名的 Ice and Snow Festival 冰雪节。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 more famous；最高级 most famous

examples.en: The panda looks fat and cute.
examples.zh: 这只熊猫看起来又胖又可爱。

examples.en: Do not eat too much fat food when you travel.
examples.zh: 旅行时不要吃太多油腻食物。

examples.en: The fat cat stayed at home.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：fat 音近「法特」，法特 is fat 胖的。
形象联想：想象 fat 胖的 panda 和 thin 瘦的 cat 对比。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 fatter；最高级 fattest

examples.en: We will go back home tomorrow.
When did you go back from Harbin?
examples.zh: 你什么时候从哈尔滨回来的？

examples.en: Let us go back along the river.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：go 去 + back 回，go back 是回到。

examples.en: We went to the Ice and Snow Festival in Harbin.
examples.zh: 我们去了哈尔滨的冰雪节。

examples.en: The Ice and Snow Festival is famous around the world.
examples.zh: 冰雪节在全世界都很有名。

examples.en: I want to travel to the Ice and Snow Festival.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：Ice 冰 + Snow 雪 + Festival 节，Ice and Snow Festival 是冰雪节。

examples.en: She made a snow sculpture at the festival.
examples.zh: 她在冰雪节上做了一个冰雕。

examples.en: We made a plan to travel along the Yangtze River.
examples.zh: 我们制定了沿长江旅行的计划。

examples.en: The students made a model of the river.
examples.zh: 学生们做了一个长江模型。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：She made a snow sculpture. made 是 make 的过去式，制作了。

reveal.inflectionNote: make 的过去式

examples.en: Show me your travel photos, please.
examples.zh: 请给我看看你的旅行照片。

examples.en: The guide will show us famous places along the river.
examples.zh: 导游会带我们看沿江的名胜。

examples.en: Can you show your ticket?

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Show me your photos. show 是给……看。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 shows；过去式 showed

examples.en: The Yangtze River is the longest river in China.
examples.zh: 长江是中国最长的河流。

examples.en: We traveled along the Yangtze River last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天我们沿长江旅行。

examples.en: Many famous cities are on the Yangtze River.
examples.zh: 许多著名城市在长江沿岸。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：Yangtze 长江 + River 河，the Yangtze River 是长江。

examples.en: The ice on the river looks thin.
examples.zh: 河上的冰看起来变薄了。

examples.en: She is thin but very strong.
The thin book is easy to carry.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 thin 瘦的 ice 冰 along 沿江。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 thinner；最高级 thinnest

examples.en: We travel to Harbin for the Ice and Snow Festival.
examples.zh: 我们去哈尔滨参加冰雪节旅行。

examples.en: I love to travel along famous rivers.
examples.zh: 我喜欢沿著名河流旅行。

examples.en: Travel makes us happy.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 travel 旅行沿 the Yangtze River 长江。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 travels；过去式 traveled/travelled

examples.en: Be careful! Do not break your leg.
Do not break the glass.
The boy can break the stick.
examples.zh: 男孩打碎了轻薄的玻璃杯。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Do not break your leg. break 是摔断，过去式 broke。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 breaks；过去式 broke；过去分词 broken

examples.en: Can you carry this heavy bag?
She can carry her lesson book every day.
The worker can carry a box to the truck.
examples.zh: 工人把箱子搬到卡车上。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Carry this heavy bag. carry 是携带、搬运。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 carries；过去式 carried

examples.en: I feel heavy after carrying the bag.
Do you feel better soon?
I feel happy when the lesson is light.
examples.zh: 功课少的时候我很开心。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I feel better soon. feel 是感觉到。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 feels；过去式 felt

examples.en: Did you hear the good news?
I cannot hear you. Speak louder, please.
examples.zh: 我听不见你说话。请大声点。

examples.en: We hear birds singing in the morning.
examples.zh: 我们早晨听见鸟儿歌唱。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：hear 音近「希尔」，希尔 hear 听见。
语义联想：把「听见」和英文 hear 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 hears；过去式 heard

examples.en: This box is too heavy for me.
examples.zh: 这个箱子对我来说太重了。

examples.en: The heavy bag made him tired.
Carry the heavy things carefully.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：heavy 音近「海维」，海维 carry heavy 重的。
形象联想：想象 carry heavy 重包和 light 轻包对比。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 heavier；最高级 heaviest

examples.en: I hope you feel better soon.
examples.zh: 希望你不久就会好起来。

examples.en: We hope the lesson is not too heavy today.
examples.zh: 希望今天的功课别太重。

examples.en: I hope I can carry it by myself.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：hope 音近「厚普」，厚普 hope 希望。
语义联想：把「希望」和英文 hope 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 hopes；过去式 hoped

examples.en: We have an English lesson this morning.
examples.zh: 今天上午我们有英语课。

examples.en: The lesson today is about jobs.
examples.zh: 今天的课文是关于职业的。

examples.en: Please open your books to Lesson 2.
examples.zh: 请打开课本翻到第二课。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：lesson 音近「莱森」，莱森上 lesson 课。
语义联想：把「功课」和英文 lesson 配对记忆。

examples.en: This bag is light. I can carry it.
The light box is easy to move.
Turn on the light, please.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：light 音近「莱特」，莱特拿 light 轻的。
形象联想：想象 light 轻的 bag 和 heavy 重的 box 对比。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 lighter；最高级 lightest（作「轻的」讲）

examples.en: I hope you get well soon.
The school bus will come soon.
We will finish the lesson soon.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：soon 音近「苏恩」，苏恩 hope soon 不久。
语义联想：把「不久」和英文 soon 配对记忆。

examples.en: Drink a lot of water when you have a fever.
There are a lot of people in the street.
The doctor gave me a lot of advice.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：a lot 大量 + of 的，a lot of 是大量的。

examples.en: Look both ways before you cross the street.
Do not cross the road when the light is red.
We cross the street to the hospital.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：cross 音近「克罗斯」，克罗斯 cross 横穿。
语义联想：把「横穿」和英文 cross 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 crosses；过去式 crossed

examples.en: You must see a doctor when you are ill.
The doctor said I have a fever.
The doctor gave me some medicine.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：doctor 音近「道克特」，道克特是 doctor 医生。
形象联想：想象 doctor 医生在 hospital 给 ill 病人开 medicine。

examples.en: I have a fever and a headache.
You must stay in bed if you have a fever.
The doctor checked my fever.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：fever 音近「菲弗」，菲弗 have fever 发烧。
语义联想：把「发烧」和英文 fever 配对记忆。

examples.en: I have a cold and cannot go to school.
She has a cold and needs to rest.
Drink warm water when you have a cold.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：have 有 + a cold 感冒，have a cold 是感冒。

examples.en: I have a headache today.
A fever can give you a headache.
Rest in bed if you have a headache.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I have a headache. headache 是头疼。

examples.en: She is ill and cannot come to class.
You must see a doctor when you feel ill.
examples.zh: 感觉不适时必须看医生。

examples.en: My brother has been ill for two days.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：ill 音近「伊尔」，伊尔 feel ill 生病。
语义联想：看到「不适」的事物时，就想到 ill。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 worse（与 well 相对）；ill 也可作副词

examples.en: Take this medicine three times a day.
The doctor gave me some medicine for my cold.
You must finish all the medicine.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：medicine 音近「麦德森」，麦德森 take medicine 吃药。
形象联想：想象 doctor 给 fever 病人 medicine 药。

examples.en: You must see a doctor.
We must cross the street carefully.
You must take your medicine on time.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：must 音近「马斯特」，马斯特说 must 必须。
语义联想：把「必须」和英文 must 配对记忆。

examples.en: You mustn't eat cold food when you are ill.
examples.zh: 生病时不许吃冷的东西。

examples.en: You mustn't cross the street when the light is red.
You mustn't open the medicine by yourself.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：must 必须 + not 不，must not 是不允许。

examples.en: Open your mouth, please.
Open the window and let fresh air in.
examples.zh: 打开窗户让新鲜空气进来。

examples.en: Open the medicine box carefully.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：open 音近「欧喷」，欧喷 open 打开。
语义联想：把「张开」和英文 open 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 opens；过去式 opened

examples.en: Do not play in the street.
The hospital is across the street.
There are a lot of cars on the street.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：street 音近「斯特里特」，斯特里特 cross street 过马路。
语义联想：把「街」和英文 street 配对记忆。

examples.en: I have a toothache and need to see a doctor.
A toothache can keep you awake at night.
examples.zh: 牙疼会让人夜里睡不着。

examples.en: You must not eat sweets when you have a toothache.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I have a toothache. toothache 是牙疼。

examples.en: Something is wrong with my stomach.
You took the wrong medicine.
What is wrong with you today?

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Something is wrong. wrong 是不正常、不对。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 more wrong；最高级 most wrong

examples.en: We had dinner in the dining room.
Mother cooked a big meal in the dining room.
examples.zh: 妈妈在餐厅做了一顿大餐。

examples.en: The dining room looks beautiful tonight.
examples.zh: 餐厅今晚看起来很漂亮。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：dining 用餐 + room 房间，dining room 是餐厅。

examples.en: What kind of food do you like?
Mother is very kind to us.
This kind of surprise makes her happy.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：What kind of food? kind 是种、类。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 kinds

examples.en: I kiss my mother on Mother's Day.
examples.zh: 母亲节那天我亲吻妈妈。

examples.en: She gave her mom a kiss and a hug.
examples.zh: 她给了妈妈一个吻和拥抱。

examples.en: A kiss shows your love.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：kiss 音近「基斯」，基斯 kiss 亲吻。
语义联想：把「亲吻」和英文 kiss 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 kisses；过去式 kissed

examples.en: I love my mother very much.
We love the surprise dinner.
examples.zh: 我们很喜欢这顿惊喜晚餐。

examples.en: Mother's Day is a day to show love.
examples.zh: 母亲节是表达爱的日子。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：love 音近「拉夫」，拉夫 love 爱。
语义联想：把「爱」和英文 love 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 loves；过去式 loved

examples.en: We ate at a nice restaurant on Mother's Day.
examples.zh: 母亲节我们在一家很好的餐馆吃饭。

examples.en: The restaurant near our school is famous.
examples.zh: 学校附近的餐馆很有名。

examples.en: Father took us to a restaurant as a surprise.
examples.zh: 爸爸带我们去了餐馆，这是个惊喜。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：restaurant 音近「瑞斯托朗」，瑞斯托朗在 restaurant 餐馆。
形象联想：想象 restaurant 餐馆里 cook 厨师做饭。

examples.en: We gave Mother a big surprise.
examples.zh: 我们给了妈妈一个大惊喜。

examples.en: The dinner was a wonderful surprise.
examples.zh: 这顿晚餐是个美好的惊喜。

examples.en: What a nice surprise!

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：surprise 音近「瑟普莱斯」，瑟普莱斯 give surprise 惊喜。
语义联想：把「惊讶」和英文 surprise 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 surprises；过去式 surprised

examples.en: My aunt is a cook in a restaurant.
examples.zh: 我姑姑是一家餐馆的厨师。

examples.en: The cook makes delicious food.
A cook works in the kitchen.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：cook 音近「库克」，库克是 cook 厨师。
语义联想：把「厨师」和英文 cook 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 cooks；过去式 cooked

examples.en: She wants to be a dancer.
The dancer performs on stage.
examples.zh: 舞蹈演员在舞台上表演。

examples.en: My sister is a good dancer.
examples.zh: 我姐姐是个优秀的舞蹈演员。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：She wants to be a dancer. dancer 是舞蹈演员。

examples.en: My grandfather is a farmer.
The farmer grows vegetables on the farm.
The farmer works hard every day.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：farmer 音近「法默」，法默是 farmer 农民。
形象联想：想象 farmer 农民在 farm grow 种 vegetables。

examples.en: Farmers grow rice and corn.
We grow flowers in the school garden.
Apples grow on trees.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：grow 音近「格柔」，格柔 grow 种植。
语义联想：把「种植」和英文 grow 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 grows；过去式 grew

examples.en: What job do you want in the future?
Teaching is a great job.
My father likes his job.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：job 音近「乔布」，乔布找 job 工作。
语义联想：把「工作」和英文 job 配对记忆。

examples.en: The nurse helps the doctor.
She wants to be a nurse.
The nurse is very kind to patients.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：nurse 音近「讷斯」，讷斯是 nurse 护士。
语义联想：把「护士」和英文 nurse 配对记忆。

examples.en: The police officer keeps us safe.
He wants to be a police officer.
A police officer works on the street.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：police 警察 + officer 官员，police officer 是警察。

examples.en: She is a famous singer.
The singer sang a beautiful song.
examples.zh: 歌手唱了一首优美的歌。

examples.en: My brother wants to be a singer.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：singer 音近「辛格」，辛格是 singer 歌手。
语义联想：把「歌唱演员」和英文 singer 配对记忆。

examples.en: My uncle is a factory worker.
The worker builds our city.
The worker can carry heavy boxes every day.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：worker 音近「沃克」，沃克是 worker 工人。
语义联想：把「工人」和英文 worker 配对记忆。

examples.en: My father is a bus driver.
examples.zh: 我爸爸是公共汽车司机。

examples.en: The driver drives carefully on the street.
examples.zh: 司机在街道上小心驾驶。

examples.en: A good driver must follow the rules.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：driver 音近「德莱弗」，德莱弗是 driver 司机。
语义联想：把「司机」和英文 driver 配对记忆。

examples.en: We learn about different jobs at school.
examples.zh: 我们在学校了解不同职业。

examples.en: I want to learn to be a scientist.
examples.zh: 我想学习成为一名科学家。

examples.en: Children learn from their parents.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：learn 音近「勒恩」，勒恩 learn 学习。
语义联想：把「学习」和英文 learn 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 learns；过去式 learned/learnt

examples.en: Edison was a great scientist.
examples.zh: 爱迪生是伟大的科学家。

examples.en: The scientist works in a lab.
I hope to become a scientist one day.
examples.zh: 我希望有一天成为科学家。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：scientist 音近「赛恩提斯特」，赛恩提斯特是 scientist 科学家。
语义联想：把「科学家」和英文 scientist 配对记忆。

examples.en: It is true that Edison was an inventor.
examples.zh: 爱迪生是发明家，这是真的。

examples.en: Is it true that you want to be a driver?
Dream big and work hard. That is true.
examples.zh: 志存高远、努力奋斗，这话没错。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：true 音近「楚」，楚说 true 确实。
语义联想：看到「确实的」的事物时，就想到 true。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 truer；最高级 truest

examples.en: There is a bottle on the lab table.
Do not open the chemical bottle.
Put the bottle back after class.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：bottle 音近「博头」，博头拿 bottle 瓶子。
语义联想：把「瓶子」和英文 bottle 配对记忆。

examples.en: Chemistry is my favorite subject.
examples.zh: 化学是我最喜欢的科目。

examples.en: We have a chemistry lesson in the lab.
examples.zh: 我们在实验室上化学课。

examples.en: Chemistry helps us understand the world.
examples.zh: 化学帮助我们认识世界。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：chemistry 音近「凯米斯特里」，凯米斯特里学 chemistry 化学。
语义联想：把「化学」和英文 chemistry 配对记忆。

examples.en: Edison was a famous inventor.
We learned about Edison in history class.
examples.zh: 我们在历史课上学了爱迪生。

examples.en: Edison worked hard in his lab.
examples.zh: 爱迪生在实验室里勤奋工作。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 Edison 爱迪生在 lab 发明 light bulb。

examples.en: Geography teaches us about the earth.
We study rivers in geography class.
examples.zh: 我们在地理课学习河流。

examples.en: Geography is an interesting subject.
examples.zh: 地理是一门有趣的科目。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：geography 音近「吉奥格拉菲」，吉奥格拉菲学 geography 地理。
语义联想：把「地理」和英文 geography 配对记忆。

examples.en: We read about Edison in history.
examples.zh: 我们在历史课读爱迪生的故事。

examples.en: History tells us about the past.
examples.zh: 历史告诉我们过去的事。

examples.en: I like the history subject at school.
examples.zh: 我喜欢学校的历史科目。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：history 音近「希斯托里」，希斯托里学 history 历史。
语义联想：把「历史」和英文 history 配对记忆。

examples.en: Edison was a great inventor.
examples.zh: 爱迪生是伟大的发明家。

examples.en: An inventor creates new things.
I want to be an inventor like Edison.
examples.zh: 我想成为像爱迪生一样的发明家。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 inventor 发明家 Edison 在 lab 工作。

examples.en: We do experiments in the lab.
The chemistry lab is on the second floor.
Students must follow rules in the lab.
examples.zh: 学生在实验室必须遵守规则。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 scientist 在 lab 实验室做 chemistry 实验。

examples.en: I will go to middle school next year.
Middle school has many new subjects.

examples.zh: 我们在中学学物理和化学。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：middle 中间 + school 学校，middle school 是中学。

examples.en: Physics is a subject in middle school.

examples.en: We learn about light in physics class.

examples.zh: 在实验室做物理实验很有趣。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：physics 音近「菲兹克斯」，菲兹克斯学 physics 物理。

examples.en: We study many subjects in middle school.
examples.zh: 我们在中学学习许多科目。

examples.en: I study chemistry and physics after class.

examples.zh: 努力学习就会取得好成绩。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：study 音近「斯塔迪」，斯塔迪 study 学习。
语义联想：把「学习」和英文 study 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 studies；过去式 studied

examples.en: What is your favorite subject?

examples.en: Chemistry is a new subject for us.

examples.en: English is my favourite subject.

mnemonic.text:

examples.en: Write your address in the year book.

examples.en: What is your home address?

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：address 音近「阿德瑞斯」，阿德瑞斯写 address 地址。

examples.en: She gave me her year book.
examples.zh: 她把毕业留念册给了我。

examples.en: Our teacher gave us good advice.
He gave his address to his classmates.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：She gave me her year book. gave 是 give 的过去式，给了。

reveal.inflectionNote: give 的过去式

examples.en: Write your information in the year book.
examples.zh: 在毕业留念册上填写你的信息。

examples.en: I need more information about the school.
examples.zh: 我需要更多关于学校的信息。

examples.en: Please leave your contact information.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Write your information. information 是信息。

examples.en: We will leave middle school soon.
examples.zh: 我们很快就要离开中学了。

examples.zh: 毕业那天就是我们离开学校的日子。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：leave 音近「里夫」，里夫 leave 离开。

examples.en: I will miss my teachers and classmates.

examples.zh: 我们都怀念快乐的校园时光。

mnemonic.text:
